title: FxEmbed following endpoint discovered

title: One-time personal-follow cleanup
intent: Adi wanted to keep personal friends/small accounts out of the candidate universe, exclude his own account from the visible Registry, and asked whether a higher threshold would improve quality.

Removed 129 lower-follower source facts/edges; deleted 127 accounts/channels/provisional entities that had no independent evidence; preserved two lower-follower accounts supported by other sources; removed `@adithyan_ai` from the visible Registry while retaining it as the graph source for surviving edges.
evidence: 638 qualifying follows remain, minimum 2,001 followers; all 638 have follower counts and 628 have bios. Current DB: 2,967 graph accounts, 2,966 visible entities, 2,998 channels/links, 12,664 facts, 361,863 graph edges, and 21,133 observations. Zero unowned/multiply-owned channels; SQLite integrity `ok`. Qualitative stratified review found a strong core of frontier researchers/lab staff/AI builders, with residual scope noise from products, media, VCs, general software, and communities.
